scope: Owner-requested backend items 2 and 3 from invitation/print latency audit, plus Gemini 45s and HTTP 60s. Frontend separately owned.

verification.isolation: Managed worktree based on baseline; only the 31 owned files copied. node_modules/generated Prisma client are local junctions. No .env or credentials copied. Clean environment defaults exclude unrelated local auth TTL and performance edits.
verification.runtime: Node.js 24.21.0; PostgreSQL 18.6 task-owned disposable cluster, loopback port 55445, synthetic random-name databases/schemas and a migrated disposable base database, shared_buffers=128MB, 2 Vitest workers.
verification.databaseLimitations: Local fast test cluster disables fsync/full_page_writes/synchronous_commit; it proves transactional application behavior and regression assertions, not deployment durability, production performance or PostgreSQL 17 exact-head CI.

mutation.execution: Primary checkout diagnostic, controlled providers and the task-owned disposable cluster; full clean-worktree validation uses the original predicate. The failed assertion was RequestInProgressError at assertLease after token ownership was deliberately inverted.

regressions: Couple print list bounds line/revision reads at page sizes 1/3/20, tied-timestamp cursor, immutable accepted prices and current pending proposals, current authority on populated/empty pages.
Real PostgreSQL AI and derive with a single connection: provider, upload and Sharp work see no active booking transaction; unrelated booking commands and revocation can progress.

Durable claim ownership/expiry/takeover, same-key concurrency and changed-body denial, cutoff/source revision rechecks, quota reservation shared with ordinary uploads, deadline and disconnect recovery, acceptance rollback and no repeated paid call.

earlierAttempts.dirtyCheckout: Not accepted: local .env defaults and concurrent resource-heavy checks produced timeouts/default-pool expectation failures. Validation was repeated in the isolated worktree.

firstIsolatedRun.cause: The disposable base public schema had not been migrated, causing database/idempotency tests to fail. The runtime-foundation assertions passed but its 10-second schema cleanup hook exceeded its budget. Applied all 62 migrations to the task-owned base DB, restarted the task-owned cluster with normal 128MB shared_buffers, then repeated the complete run. No test deadlines or coverage thresholds changed.

earlierAttempts.acceptance: Earlier focused regressions are supplemental; the final clean run and actual command exit code govern acceptance. reportOnFailure is enabled only to retain coverage diagnostics on a failed run; it does not change thresholds or test outcomes.

rollout.explicitEnvironmentRequired: Set HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=60000 when the deployment currently overrides the default.
rollout.apiContracts: No route/schema changes; existing errors and examples documented in docs/invitation-backend-latency-2026-10-20.md.
rollout.liveProviderReadiness: not established by these controlled-provider tests
rollout.remainingAcceptance: Review and exact-head CI, migration/config rollout, then deployed measurement and authorized provider environment evidence. PDF caching and ordinary-upload/signed-preview transaction restructuring remain separate follow-ups.
